p4_b5.ocr: Products produced in excess of 1 g/l fermentation broth are in bold print. source, and resistance to inhibitors. There were clear dif- ferences in carbon source utilization by the test organ- isms. Of the most important monosaccharides in lignocellulosic feedstocks, xylose is not readily fermented by S. cerevisiae and C. glutamicum, whereas arabinose is not utilized by P. stipitis. In general, filamentous fungi are less susceptible to inhibitors from lignocellulosic hydro- lysates than the other test organisms making them more robust for crude feedstock hydrolysate utilization.
